worldcombat.skill.silktrap.summary: Spins a silken web that blocks damaging attacks by a total pool and snares contact: Speed cut and the foe pinned briefly; status moves pass through.
worldcombat.skill.silktrap.description.0: The web lasts %1$s and holds %2$s points, cutting contact Speed by %3$s levels and pinning for %4$s; higher Speed and Defence make it tougher and longer.
worldcombat.skill.silktrap.description.2: Repeat-use failure rate %1$s; the snare/slide trade-off is the %2$s setting.
worldcombat.skill.silktrap.use.0: Snare a charging melee so it is slow and stuck
worldcombat.skill.silktrap.use.1: Buy time to open distance for allies
worldcombat.skill.silktrap.use.2: Soak ranged damage with the toughest web
worldcombat.skill.silktrap.preference.sn: On (snare): contact pin x1.5, drop +1, but pool x0.8, duration x0.85, recover 7 ticks. Off (slide): pool x1.25, duration x1.15, recover 5 ticks, but pin x0.6, no extra drop.
worldcombat.skill.silktrap.preference.ai: Weave once a threat enters this range. Larger sets up earlier but may waste the cast; smaller saves PP but bets the foe will close in.
